say:1:1530755001:0.text: My sister and I worked on it together.
say:1:1530755001:0.source_cn: 是我和妹妹，我们两个一起种的。
say:1:1530755001:0.male: My sister and I worked on it together.
say:1:1530755001:0.female: My sister and I worked on it together.

say:2:1530755002:0.text: After we first tasted wheat, we decided to learn how to grow it.
say:2:1530755002:0.source_cn: 在尝过小麦之后，我和妹妹就决定学习种小麦。
say:2:1530755002:0.male: After we first tasted wheat, we decided to learn how to grow it.
say:2:1530755002:0.female: After we first tasted wheat, we decided to learn how to grow it.

say:3:1530755003:0.text: Look at our wheat field. Not bad, right?
say:3:1530755003:0.source_cn: 看看我们种的这片小麦，种的不错吧！
say:3:1530755003:0.male: Look at our wheat field. Not bad, right?
say:3:1530755003:0.female: Look at our wheat field. Not bad, right?
